env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^ok$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/hoistlocal

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

// A local defined type inside a generic function is hoisted into
// export data with a vargen suffix (seq·1). Importing the package
// must not let the facts overlay force a lookup of it: the simplified
// importer cannot materialize its implicit type parameters.
func LCS[T any, Slice ~[]T](as, bs Slice) Slice {
	type seq struct {
		i, j int
		x    T
	}
	_ = seq{0, 0, *new(T)}
	return as
}

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/hoistlocal/lib"
)

func main() {
	_ = lib.LCS([]int{1}, []int{2})
	fmt.Println("ok")
}
